Cough.NAME: Cough
Cough.DESCRIPTION: You can no longer ignore what started as a tickle in your chest. Try as you might to suppress it, the scratching senation will eventually claw its way out.

Delirium.NAME: Delirium
Delirium.DESCRIPTION: Your thoughts feel distant, shuffled. Your hands shake in ways you aren't used to.

Fatigue.NAME: Fatigue
Fatigue.DESCRIPTION: Every task a mountain, every rest a drought.

Fever.NAME: Fever
Fever.DESCRIPTION: You feel the tell-tale heat, headache, and nausea. You've seen this before, you know that death is inevitable.
